'''Louis Bernatchez''' {{post-nominals|country=CAN|CQ|MSRC}} (1960 – September 28, 2023) was a Canadian professor of [[genetics]] at [[Laval University]] and a [[Canada Research Chair]] in genomics and conservation of aquatic resources.<ref name="Wellenreuther et al. 2023"/><ref name="Yates et al. 2023"/><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Rieseberg |first=Loren H. |date=2023-12-28 |title=A memorial to Professor Louis Bernatchez (1960–2023) |url=https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q124356638 |journal=Molecular Ecology |language=English |volume=33 |issue=3 |article-number=e17253 |doi=10.1111/MEC.17253}}</ref> Louis Bernatchez was a co-founder of the Canadian Society for Ecology and Evolution.<ref>(url=https://csee-scee.ca/)</ref>

Bernatchez authored over 500 scientific publications and mentored dozens of students in applying genomics and evolution to the multiple fields, including wildlife management, medicine, agriculture, aquaculture, forestry, conservation, environmental sciences, microbiology and toxicology.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Ferchaud |first1=Anne-Laure |last2=Laporte |first2=Martin |last3=Wellenreuther |first3=Maren |date=2020-07-14 |title=From the woods to the halls of science: Louis Bernatchez's contributions to science, wildlife conservation and people |url=https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q97592941 |journal=Evolutionary Applications |volume=13 |issue=6 |pages=1105–1116 |doi=10.1111/EVA.13043 |doi-access=free |pmc=7359837 |pmid=32684949 |bibcode=2020EvApp..13.1105F }}</ref>

== Select awards and honours ==
*2001 – Michel-Jurdant Prize, [[Association francophone pour le savoir|ACFAS]]
*2011 – Fellow, [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]
*2011 – Fellow, [[Royal Society of Canada]]
*2012 – [[Prix Marie-Victorin]], [[Government of Quebec]]
*2020 – Knight, [[National Order of Quebec]]<ref>{{cite web|publisher=Ordre national du Québec|title=L'Ordre national du Québec honorera des personnalités qui ont changé le visage du Québec|date=May 11, 2021|lang=fr|url=https://www.ordre-national.gouv.qc.ca/actualites/communiques/2021-05-11.asp}}</ref>
